finding_B_kernel.question: Why does rpm -q kernel-core report a different kernel than uname -r?
finding_B_kernel.KERNEL_QUERY_BEHAVIOUR: rpm -q kernel-core returns ALL installed kernel-core packages. With two kernels installed there is no correlation between the first returned line and the running kernel. rpm returns them in its own order; the validator then keeps the first '.x86_64' match, which was the fc43 one.

recommended_source_for_future_fix.why: authoritative for the RUNNING kernel; no package query needed
